comment: Vendor roles for the pipeline (DAV-376). The drafter and the verifier must be different vendors; scripts/verify.ts refuses to run otherwise. Models are recorded verbatim on every entry and record. max_entries_per_run caps the model calls one run may make (0 = no cap). Verifier measured 2026-10-23 on two entries: gpt-6.1-sol at medium reached the same verdicts as gpt-6-astra at high for about a sixth of the price; the luna models missed an unstated conflict and would have published an entry astra held.
